overview.title: Overview

hub.title: Connection to the service
hub.subscriptionHint: The portal needs an active subscription. Check your account at
hub.keyHint: Check the API key in the server configuration and restart the service.

overview.unavailable: The service did not return these figures just now.

tickets.title: Support requests
tickets.intro: Every request your customers raised, newest first.
tickets.subject: Subject

detail.noMessages: Nothing has been written on this request yet.
detail.internalToggle: Keep this as an internal note
detail.internalHint: Your customer never sees an internal note, and the status of the request stays as it is.
detail.escalateMessage: The request "{{subject}}" goes to the support team of the platform operator and is set back to open. Your customer is not told about it.
detail.escalateDone: Request handed over to platform support
detail.escalatedHint: This request sits with platform support.

customers.title: Customers
customers.hint: Accounts with the service and the portal logins that belong to them.
customers.noLoginHint: This customer cannot sign in to this portal yet.
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one.
customers.suspendMessage: Suspend {{email}}? The portal and the service are blocked right away.
customers.deleteMessage: Delete the customer {{email}} for good? The account and the portal login go together.

dialog.createIntro: The account with the service and the portal login are created together.
dialog.sendInvite: Send the invitation by e-mail right away

balance.title: Balance
balance.hint: The prepaid wallet of the customer, in euros.
balance.insufficient: The wallet does not hold that much. Available: {{balance}}.

usage.title: Usage
usage.empty: Nothing was used in this period.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Plans are what your customers subscribe to. Type, billing cycle and allowances are fixed once a plan exists.
plans.empty: No plan has been created yet.
plans.deleteMessage: The plan "{{name}}" will be deleted. Existing subscriptions prevent that.

dialog.editIntro: Type, billing cycle and allowances of an existing plan can no longer be changed.
dialog.allowanceHint: Leave empty for use without a limit, zero for nothing included.
dialog.addonHint: On an add-on package the allowance is also the size of the package.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.intro: These two prices apply to what your customers use. Your margin is the difference.
pricing.suggestionsIntro: A suggestion only fills the fields. Nothing is stored until you save.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Every subscription ties one customer to one plan and a term.
subscriptions.cancelMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} runs for another 30 days and ends then.
subscriptions.cancelImmediateMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} ends at once. Nothing is refunded and there is no way back.

dialog.title: New subscription
dialog.intro: The subscription starts at once and ends after the chosen term.
dialog.customerHint: Only customers that already exist can hold a subscription.

addons.title: Add-on packages
addons.intro: Extra minutes and conversations a customer buys on top of a plan.

packages.title: Packages on offer
packages.intro: Each package is an add-on plan that is active and visible.
packages.empty: No package is on offer yet. Add a plan of type add-on package under Plans.

purchases.title: Sales
purchases.empty: No package has been sold yet.

dialog.title: Sell a package
dialog.intro: The credits reach the customer straight away and lapse after twelve months.

payments.balance: Take it from the customer balance

dialog.paymentHint: With the second choice no money moves and collecting it is up to you.
dialog.noPackages: There is no package on offer that could be sold.
dialog.balanceTooLow: The balance of this customer is not high enough for this.
dialog.noSubscription: This customer has no running subscription a package could add to.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Invoices you raise against your customers. Sending and collecting stay with you.
invoices.empty: No invoice has been created yet.
invoices.markPaidMessage: Invoice {{number}} is recorded as paid and stamped with today's date. No money is moved by this.

detail.noItems: This invoice has no line items.

dialog.title: Create an invoice
dialog.intro: The invoice is created as a draft. Nothing is sent and no payment is collected; the number is assigned by the system.

numbers.title: Phone numbers
numbers.intro: The number pool of your portal. Hand a free number to a customer, or take an assigned one back.
numbers.label: Label
numbers.empty: There is no free number in the pool.
numbers.emptyAssigned: No number is assigned at the moment.
numbers.releaseMessage: Number {{number}} is taken from the customer and returns to the pool. Calls to it no longer reach them afterwards.
numbers.released: The number is back in the pool.

assignDialog.title: Assign the number
assignDialog.intro: Number {{number}} goes to this customer. They can then point one of their agents at it.

importDialog.title: Import a number of your own
importDialog.intro: Bring over a number you already hold with your carrier. The credentials are passed on and never read back.
importDialog.label: Label

sip.title: SIP trunk
sip.addressHint: Host or IP of your trunk, for example sip.example.com
sip.allowedAddressesHint: Separate several with a comma. Leave empty when your carrier does not ask for it.

carrier.title: Account with the carrier
carrier.optional: Optional. Without them the account token is used.

importDialog.secretHint: Credentials are only passed on to telephony and are not shown again afterwards.

users.title: Users
users.empty: No users yet. Invite the first person.
users.linkMessage: No mail server is configured. Pass this link on in person. It is valid for a limited time only.
users.clearTwoFactorMessage: Remove the second factor of {{email}}? Until they set up a new one, the link from their mailbox is all it takes.

dialog.inviteIntro: The person receives a link that activates their account.
dialog.customerHint: Customer number from your partner account with the service. Without it the person sees no usage data.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: What your customers used and what it earned.
analytics.noUsage: Nothing was used in this period.
analytics.billedNote: The figures come from billed usage, not from open invoices.

agents.title: Customer agents
agents.intro: Every voice agent and chatbot in the portal, with its owner.
agents.name: Name
agents.openHint: Opens the portal in this customer's view.
agents.emptyAgents: No voice agent has been created yet.
agents.emptyChatbots: No chatbot has been created yet.

branding.intro: Name, logo and colour appear throughout the portal and in the e-mails.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, at most 140 KB.
branding.logoType: Please choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
branding.logoTooLarge: The logo must be 140 KB or smaller.

mail.intro: The portal sends invitations and sign-in links through this server.
mail.envSource: Configured through the server environment. Settings on this page take precedence.
mail.notConfigured: No mail server configured yet. Invitation links then have to be passed on by hand.
mail.passKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.removeMessage: The stored SMTP credentials will be deleted. The server environment applies again afterwards, if anything is configured there.

registration.intro: Who may open an account here. This is off until you switch it on.
registration.selfServiceHint: A sign-up form appears on the sign-in page. Each new account also becomes a customer of yours at the service.
registration.mailRequired: This needs a mail server. Set one up under E-mail first.

hub.intro: Company data, portal logo and payment keys of your provider account. These are kept by the service, not by the portal.
hub.companyHint: These details appear on the invoices you issue to your customers.
hub.logoHint: The logo is not uploaded. Enter the address of a file that is already reachable.
hub.paymentsHint: A stored key is never shown again. An empty field leaves the stored value untouched.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: All changes made by administrators and security-relevant events.

hub.intro: What the service recorded about your provider account: customers created, pricing changes, credentials updated.
hub.empty: The service has not recorded anything yet.
